reply_text:
I told Pree in the DM that her cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork is 21 October. That's what she said to me on 14 October, and I read it back from her own direct messages with me.

The gbrain note I saved for her couldn't be read back. gbrain refused because this connection isn't linked to any member, so it won't read on someone's behalf. Until whoever runs the gbrain server links it to members, private notes saved there can't be recalled. Their fix starts with `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`.
